For instance, the following configuration creates cache1 and cache2 caches with an entry expiration of 10 minutes:

items.source: If Redis is available and configured, a RedisCacheManager is auto-configured. It is possible to create additional caches on startup by setting the spring.cache.cache-names property and cache defaults can be configured by using spring.cache.redis.* properties. For instance, the following configuration creates cache1 and cache2 caches with a time to live of 10 minutes:
items.translation: 如果可用并配置了Redis，将自动配置一个RedisCacheManager。可以通过设置spring.cache.cache-names属性在启动时创建额外的缓存，并使用spring.cache.redis.*属性配置缓存默认值。例如，以下配置会创建具有 10 分钟生存时间的cache1和cache2缓存：

items.source: If a CacheLoader bean is defined, it is automatically associated to the CaffeineCacheManager. Since the CacheLoader is going to be associated with all caches managed by the cache manager, it must be defined as CacheLoader<Object, Object>. The auto-configuration ignores any other generic type.
items.translation: 如果定义了 CacheLoader Bean，它将自动关联到 CaffeineCacheManager。 由于 CacheLoader 将与缓存管理器管理的所有缓存关联，因此必须将其定义为 CacheLoader<Object, Object>。 自动配置会忽略任何其他泛型类型。

items.translation: 如果您未定义类型为 CacheManager 的 Bean，或未定义名为 cacheResolver 的 CacheResolver（参见 CachingConfigurer），Spring Boot 将尝试按以下顺序检测提供程序：

items.source: When @EnableCaching is present in your configuration, a suitable cache configuration is expected as well. If you have a custom ` org.springframework.cache.CacheManager`, consider defining it in a separate @Configuration class so that you can override it if necessary. None uses a no-op implementation that is useful in tests, and slice tests use that by default through @AutoConfigureCache when the spring-boot-cache-test module is present.
items.translation: 当您的配置中存在 @EnableCaching 时，也期望存在合适的缓存配置。 如果您拥有自定义的 `org.springframework.cache.CacheManager`，请考虑将其定义在一个单独的 @Configuration 类中，以便在必要时进行覆盖。 None 使用一个无操作实现，这在测试中非常有用；当存在 `spring-boot-cache-test` 模块时，切片测试会通过 @AutoConfigureCache 默认使用该实现。

items.source: JCache is bootstrapped through the presence of a CachingProvider on the classpath (that is, a JSR-107 compliant caching library exists on the classpath), and the JCacheCacheManager is provided by the spring-boot-starter-cache starter. Various compliant libraries are available, and Spring Boot provides dependency management for Ehcache 3, Hazelcast, and Infinispan. Any other compliant library can be added as well.
items.translation: JCache 通过类路径中存在 CachingProvider 进行引导（即类路径上存在符合 JSR-107 规范的缓存库），而 JCacheCacheManager 由 spring-boot-starter-cache Starter 提供。 有多种符合规范的库可供选择，Spring Boot 为 Ehcache 3、Hazelcast 和 Infinispan 提供了依赖管理。 也可以添加任何其他符合规范的库。

items.source: Spring Boot has general support for Hazelcast. If a HazelcastInstance has been auto-configured and com.hazelcast:hazelcast-spring is on the classpath, it is automatically wrapped in a CacheManager.
items.translation: Spring Boot 对 Hazelcast 提供通用支持。如果已自动配置了 HazelcastInstance 且 com.hazelcast:hazelcast-spring 在类路径中，它会自动包装为 CacheManager。

items.source: To be compatible with Spring Boot’s Jakarta EE 9 baseline, Infinispan’s -jakarta modules must be used. For every module with a -jakarta variant, the variant must be used in place of the standard module. For example, infinispan-core-jakarta and infinispan-commons-jakarta must be used in place of infinispan-core and infinispan-commons respectively.
items.translation: 为了与 Spring Boot 的 Jakarta EE 9 基线兼容，必须使用 Infinispan 的 -jakarta` 模块。对于每个具有 `-jakarta` 变体的模块，必须使用该变体来替代标准模块。例如，必须分别使用 `infinispan-core-jakarta` 和 `infinispan-commons-jakarta` 来替代 `infinispan-core` 和 `infinispan-commons。

items.source: If none of the other providers can be found, a simple implementation using a ConcurrentHashMap as the cache store is configured. This is the default if no caching library is present in your application. By default, caches are created as needed, but you can restrict the list of available caches by setting the cache-names property. For instance, if you want only cache1 and cache2 caches, set the cache-names property as follows:
items.translation: 如果找不到其他提供者，将配置一个使用ConcurrentHashMap作为缓存存储的简单实现。 如果您的应用程序中没有缓存库，这将是默认设置。 默认情况下，按需创建缓存，但您可以通过设置cache-names属性来限制可用缓存列表。 例如，如果您只想使用cache1和cache2缓存，请按如下方式设置cache-names属性：

items.source: If the CacheManager is auto-configured by Spring Boot, you can further tune its configuration before it is fully initialized by exposing a bean that implements the CacheManagerCustomizer interface. The following example sets a flag to say that null values should not be passed down to the underlying map:
items.translation: 如果 Spring Boot 自动配置了CacheManager，您可以通过暴露一个实现CacheManagerCustomizer接口的 Bean 来在其完全初始化之前进一步调整其配置。 以下示例设置一个标志，表示不应将null值传递给底层 Map：

items.source: Generic caching is used if the context defines at least one Cache bean. A CacheManager wrapping all beans of that type is created.
items.translation: 如果上下文定义了 至少 一个 Cache Bean，则使用通用缓存。 会创建一个包装该类型所有 Bean 的 CacheManager。

items.source: Caffeine is a Java 8 rewrite of Guava’s cache that supersedes support for Guava. If Caffeine is present, a CaffeineCacheManager (provided by the spring-boot-starter-cache starter) is auto-configured. Caches can be created on startup by setting the spring.cache.cache-names property and can be customized by one of the following (in the indicated order):
items.translation: Caffeine 是 Guava 缓存的 Java 8 重写版本，已取代对 Guava 的支持。如果存在 Caffeine，则会自动配置一个由 spring-boot-starter-cache 启动器提供的 CaffeineCacheManager。可以通过设置 spring.cache.cache-names 属性在启动时创建缓存，并可通过以下任一方式（按指定顺序）进行自定义：

items.source: The cache abstraction does not provide an actual store and relies on abstraction materialized by the Cache and CacheManager interfaces.
items.translation: 缓存抽象不提供实际的存储，而是依赖于由 Cache 和 CacheManager 接口实现的抽象。

items.source: CacheManagerCustomizer beans are invoked with the reference of the CacheManager for full customization.
items.translation: CacheManagerCustomizer beans 会传入 CacheManager 的引用，以进行完全自定义。

items.translation: 如果您需要更灵活地控制配置，可以考虑注册一个 CouchbaseCacheManagerBuilderCustomizer Bean。 以下示例展示了一个自定义器，它为 cache1` 和 `cache2 配置了特定的条目过期时间：

items.source: If you need more control over the configuration, consider registering a RedisCacheManagerBuilderCustomizer bean. The following example shows a customizer that configures a specific time to live for cache1 and cache2:

items.source: This example demonstrates the use of caching on a potentially costly operation. Before invoking computePiDecimal, the abstraction looks for an entry in the piDecimals cache that matches the precision argument. If an entry is found, the content in the cache is immediately returned to the caller, and the method is not invoked. Otherwise, the method is invoked, and the cache is updated before returning the value.
items.translation: 本示例演示了在潜在高成本操作上使用缓存。在调用 computePiDecimal 之前，抽象层会在 piDecimals 缓存中查找与 precision 参数匹配的条目。如果找到该条目，则立即将缓存中的内容返回给调用者，而不调用该方法。否则，调用该方法，并在返回值之前更新缓存。

items.source: If you do not add any specific cache library, Spring Boot auto-configures a simple provider that uses concurrent maps in memory. When a cache is required (such as piDecimals in the preceding example), this provider creates it for you. The simple provider is not really recommended for production usage, but it is great for getting started and making sure that you understand the features. When you have made up your mind about the cache provider to use, please make sure to read its documentation to figure out how to configure the caches that your application uses. Nearly all providers require you to explicitly configure every cache that you use in the application. Some offer a way to customize the default caches defined by the spring.cache.cache-names property.
items.translation: 如果您未添加任何特定的缓存库，Spring Boot 会自动配置一个简单提供者，该提供者在内存中使用并发 Map。 当需要缓存（例如前例中的piDecimals）时，此提供者会为您创建它。 简单提供者并不真正推荐用于生产环境，但它非常适合入门并确保您理解相关功能。 当您决定使用哪种缓存提供者后，请务必阅读其文档以了解如何配置应用程序所使用的缓存。 几乎所有提供者都要求您在应用程序中显式配置每个使用的缓存。 有些提供自定义由spring.cache.cache-names属性定义的默认缓存的方法。

items.source: Caches can be created on startup by setting the spring.cache.cache-names property. If a custom Configuration bean is defined, it is used to customize them.
items.translation: 可以通过设置 spring.cache.cache-names 属性在启动时创建缓存。如果定义了自定义的 Configuration Bean，则使用它来对其进行定制。

items.source: Caches can be created on startup by setting the spring.cache.cache-names property. If a custom ConfigurationBuilder bean is defined, it is used to customize the caches.
items.translation: 可以通过设置 spring.cache.cache-names 属性在启动时创建缓存。如果定义了自定义的 ConfigurationBuilder Bean，则使用它来定制缓存。

items.source: For instance, the following configuration creates cache1 and cache2 caches with a maximum size of 500 and a time to live of 10 minutes
items.translation: 例如，以下配置会创建名为 `cache1` 和 `cache2` 的缓存，其最大大小为 500，且生存时间（time to live）为 10 分钟。

items.source: Caches can be created on startup by setting the spring.cache.cache-names property. Cache defaults can be customized using a Cache2kBuilderCustomizer bean. The following example shows a customizer that configures the capacity of the cache to 200 entries, with an expiration of 5 minutes:
items.translation: 可以通过设置 spring.cache.cache-names 属性在启动时创建缓存。可以使用一个 Cache2kBuilderCustomizer Bean 来自定义缓存默认值。以下示例展示了一个自定义器，它将缓存容量配置为 200 个条目，过期时间为 5 分钟：

items.source: The Spring Framework provides support for transparently adding caching to an application. At its core, the abstraction applies caching to methods, thus reducing the number of executions based on the information available in the cache. The caching logic is applied transparently, without any interference to the invoker. Spring Boot auto-configures the cache infrastructure as long as caching support is enabled by using the @EnableCaching annotation.
items.translation: Spring Framework 为应用程序透明地添加缓存支持。其核心抽象将缓存应用于方法，从而根据缓存中可用的信息减少执行次数。缓存逻辑被透明应用，对调用者没有任何干扰。只要使用 @EnableCaching 注解启用缓存支持，Spring Boot 就会自动配置缓存基础设施。

items.source: Additionally, Spring Boot for Apache Geode provides auto-configuration for using Apache Geode as a cache provider.
items.translation: 此外，Spring Boot for Apache Geode 提供了使用 Apache Geode 作为缓存提供程序的自动配置。

items.source: There are two ways to customize the underlying CacheManager:
items.translation: 有两种方式自定义底层CacheManager：

items.source: A CaffeineSpec bean is defined
items.translation: 已定义一个 CaffeineSpec 类型的 bean。

items.source: A Caffeine bean is defined
items.translation: 已定义一个 Caffeine Bean。

items.source: Cache2k is an in-memory cache. If the Cache2k spring integration is present, a SpringCache2kCacheManager is auto-configured.
items.translation: Cache2k 是一个内存缓存。如果存在 Cache2k Spring 集成，将自动配置一个 SpringCache2kCacheManager。

items.source: JCache (JSR-107) (EhCache 3, Hazelcast, Infinispan, and others)
items.translation: JCache (JSR-107)（EhCache 3、Hazelcast、Infinispan 等）

items.source: Infinispan has no default configuration file location, so it must be specified explicitly. Otherwise, the default bootstrap is used.
items.translation: Infinispan 没有默认的配置文件位置，因此必须显式指定。否则，将使用默认引导程序。

items.source: A cache spec defined by spring.cache.caffeine.spec
items.translation: 由 spring.cache.caffeine.spec 定义的缓存规范

items.source: If you need to use a no-op cache rather than the auto-configured cache manager in a certain environment, set the cache type to none, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 如果您需要在特定环境中使用空操作缓存（no-op cache）而非自动配置的缓存管理器，请将缓存类型设置为 none，如下例所示：

items.translation: 简而言之，要向服务的操作添加缓存功能，只需在其方法上添加相应的注解，如下例所示：

items.source:
It might happen that more than one provider is present, in which case the provider must be explicitly specified.
Even if the JSR-107 standard does not enforce a standardized way to define the location of the configuration file, Spring Boot does its best to accommodate setting a cache with implementation details, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 可能会出现多个 Provider 并存的情况，此时必须显式指定 Provider。即使 JSR-107 标准并未强制规定配置文件位置的标准化方式，Spring Boot 也会尽力支持通过实现细节来配置缓存，如下例所示：

items.source:
If you do so and your application uses a cache not listed, then it fails at runtime when the cache is needed, but not on startup.
This is similar to the way the "real" cache providers behave if you use an undeclared cache.
items.translation:
如果您这样做，且您的应用程序使用了未列出的缓存，则在需要该缓存时会在运行时失败，但不会在启动时失败。  
这与使用未声明的缓存时“真实”缓存提供程序的行为方式类似。

items.source: Hazelcast can be used as a JCache compliant cache or as a Spring CacheManager compliant cache. When setting spring.cache.type to hazelcast, Spring Boot will use the CacheManager based implementation. If you want to use Hazelcast as a JCache compliant cache, set spring.cache.type to jcache. If you have multiple JCache compliant cache providers and want to force the use of Hazelcast, you have to explicitly set the JCache provider.
items.translation: Hazelcast 可作为符合 JCache 规范的缓存，或作为符合 Spring CacheManager 规范的缓存使用。 当将 spring.cache.type 设置为 hazelcast 时，Spring Boot 将使用基于 CacheManager 的实现。 如果您想将 Hazelcast 用作符合 JCache 规范的缓存，请将 spring.cache.type 设置为 jcache。 如果您有多个符合 JCache 规范的缓存提供者，并希望强制使用 Hazelcast，则必须显式设置 JCache 提供者。

items.source: In the preceding example, an auto-configured ConcurrentMapCacheManager is expected. If that is not the case (either you provided your own config or a different cache provider was auto-configured), the customizer is not invoked at all. You can have as many customizers as you want, and you can also order them by using @Order or Ordered.
items.translation: 在上面的示例中，预期会配置一个 ConcurrentMapCacheManager。 如果并非如此（即您提供了自己的配置，或者自动配置了不同的缓存提供者），则完全不会调用该自定义器。 您可以拥有任意数量的自定义器，并且可以通过使用 @Order 或 Ordered 来对它们进行排序。

items.source: Spring Boot has general support for Hazelcast. If a single HazelcastInstance is available, it is automatically reused for the CacheManager as well, unless the spring.cache.jcache.config property is specified.
items.translation: Spring Boot 对 Hazelcast 提供通用支持。如果存在单个HazelcastInstance，除非指定了spring.cache.jcache.config属性，否则该实例也会被自动重用于CacheManager。

items.source: If the CacheManager is auto-configured by Spring Boot, it is possible to force a particular cache provider by setting the spring.cache.type property. Use this property if you need to use no-op caches in certain environments (such as tests).
items.translation: 如果 Spring Boot 自动配置了 CacheManager，您可以通过设置 spring.cache.type 属性来强制使用特定的缓存提供者。 如果您需要在某些环境（例如测试）中使用空操作缓存，请使用此属性。

items.source: If a standard CacheManager bean is defined, it is wrapped automatically in an CacheManager implementation that the abstraction expects. No further customization is applied to it.
items.translation: 如果定义了标准的 CacheManager Bean，它会自动被包装成抽象层所期望的 CacheManager 实现。 不会对其应用进一步的自定义配置。

items.source: You can take full control of the default configuration by adding a RedisCacheConfiguration @Bean of your own. This can be useful if you need to customize the default serialization strategy.
items.translation: 您可以通过添加自己的 RedisCacheConfiguration @Bean 来完全控制默认配置。 如果您需要自定义默认的序列化策略，这将非常有用。

items.source: Use the spring-boot-starter-cache starter to quickly add basic caching dependencies. The starter brings in spring-context-support. If you add dependencies manually, you must include spring-context-support in order to use the JCache or Caffeine support.
items.translation: 使用 spring-boot-starter-cache 启动器快速添加基本的缓存依赖。 该启动器引入了 spring-context-support。 如果您手动添加依赖，必须包含 spring-context-support 才能使用 JCache 或 Caffeine 支持。

items.source: You can also use the standard JSR-107 (JCache) annotations (such as @CacheResult) transparently. However, we strongly advise you to not mix and match the Spring Cache and JCache annotations.
items.translation: 您也可以透明地使用标准的 JSR-107 (JCache) 注解（例如 @CacheResult）。 然而，我们强烈建议您不要混合使用 Spring Cache 和 JCache 注解。

items.source: It is also possible to transparently update or evict data from the cache.
items.translation: 也可以透明地更新或驱逐缓存中的数据。

items.source: By default, a key prefix is added so that, if two separate caches use the same key, Redis does not have overlapping keys and cannot return invalid values. We strongly recommend keeping this setting enabled if you create your own RedisCacheManager.
items.translation: 默认情况下，会添加一个键前缀，这样如果两个独立的缓存使用相同的键，Redis 就不会有重叠的键，也不会返回无效的值。 如果您自己创建 RedisCacheManager，我们强烈建议保持此设置启用。

items.source: Check the relevant section of the Spring Framework reference for more details.
items.translation: 有关更多详细信息，请检查 Spring Framework 参考中的相关部分。

items.source: When a cache library offers both a native implementation and JSR-107 support, Spring Boot prefers the JSR-107 support, so that the same features are available if you switch to a different JSR-107 implementation.
items.translation: 当缓存库同时提供原生实现和 JSR-107 支持时，Spring Boot 优先选择 JSR-107 支持，以便在切换到不同的 JSR-107 实现时，这些功能依然可用。
